messages:
emma: Postmortem draft: region-network partition caused spikes in TCP timeouts to the model-registry service. Registry writes drifted, auth provider returned 429s after the token refresh burst. Customer-facing API saw elevated 502s. Need concrete follow-ups: registry mirror, client-side throttling, enhanced vendor SLAs, and runbook checks.

rafi: I can take the registry mirror work. Proposal: an async write-to-primary + best-effort replicate-to-secondary pattern. Secondary becomes read-only failover. Will sketch PR.

owen: I will own client throttling and circuit-breaker defaults. Current clients retry aggressively when write fails; that amplified load. I suggest default backoff to 1s base, max 10s, and a 90s circuit open after 5 consecutive write errors.

priya: Product asks for customer communication template and timeline for SLA changes. Also want to understand data-loss risk with mirror approach. Please add a short note in the follow-up doc.

vendor-bot: Vendor update: auth-provider ticket #AUTH-981 opened. Vendor acknowledgement: "rate-limit regression observed after config rollout". ETA for mitigation: 2026-04-02.

emma: Action items & owners: rafi - mirror design doc + PoC (due 2026-03-30), owen - client throttle PR + canary (due 2026-03-26), priya - communication + SLA ask (due 2026-03-24), emma - runbook + postmortem writeup (due 2026-03-25). I'll add these to the incident board.

rafi: Mirror sketch snippet I'll use in the doc:
```
# on write path
write_primary(payload)
spawn_background(replicate_to_secondary, payload)
# read path fallback
if primary_unavailable:
    read_secondary()
```

owen: throttle config example for clients:
```
THROTTLE_CONFIG = {
  "base_backoff_sec": 1,
  "max_backoff_sec": 10,
  "max_retries": 4,
  "circuit_open_after": 5,
}
```

priya: Risk note: mirror solves availability but could cause eventual consistency for ingestion. We'll need customers to opt-in to cross-region replication for strong guarantees. I'll draft copy for opt-in settings.

emma: Monitoring changes: add metric registry_write_error_rate per region, alert if >1% for 3m; add spike alert for auth_429_rate and a golden signal for registry replication lag > 10s. Also add synthetic write that runs every 30s to each region.

nate: Deploy planner: canary for client throttle change scheduled 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z. Will ping #eng-oncall at start.

vendor-bot: Vendor note: requested soft SLA credits for incident window. Contact assigned: vendor-tam@provider.com.

rafa: Security check: ensure replicated payloads are encrypted in transit and that no tokens are persisted in logs. I'll coordinate with sec team.

emma: Recurrence plan: monthly review of vendor rate-limit config rollouts and a weekly histogram of token refresh rates. Also add a gating check in deploy pipeline for auth-provider config changes.

owen: Quick sync Monday 11am PT to confirm PR landed and runbook updates.

priya: +1

rafi: +1

emma: Thanks all. Please link PRs/tickets in the incident board. I'll close follow-ups once mirror PoC, throttle PR, and runbook are done.
